props.gloss_en: from one suspected of selling teruma as non-sacred produce one does not buy even water and salt
anything that bears a connection to teruma and tithes one does not buy from him
[R' Shimon's 'anything'] comes to include fish innards
for they mix olive oil into them
a certain butcher was suspected of selling fat of the thigh [region] as intestinal fat
Rava penalized him [forbidding him] to sell even nuts
actually, [the ruling is according to] R' Shimon
and we penalize him in [a matter of] the prohibition itself
ordinary children are enticed by nuts; he goes and misleads the butchers' children and entices them with nuts, and they bring him thigh fat, and he sells it as intestinal fat

objections.gloss_en: אמר ליה רב פפא לרבא: כמאן? כרבי יהודה? אי כרבי יהודה, אפילו מים ומלח נמי! -- if your penalty follows R' Yehuda, forbid even water and salt

answered_by.gloss_en: לעולם רבי שמעון, ובאיסורא דגופיה קנסינן ליה -- actually R' Shimon; the nuts are the very means of the prohibition: with them he enticed the butchers' children to bring him the thigh fat
